items.title: WebAssembly Security: The Sandbox That Is Not What You Think
items.summary: WebAssembly runs at near-native speed inside a browser sandbox. But the sandbox is not bulletproof — linear memory without ASLR, Spectre side channels, and persistent malware hiding in WASM modules are real threats. Here is how WASM security actually works and where it falls short.
items.interpretation: 这类事件往往暴露真实瓶颈：算力、数据中心和安全性才是大规模落地的关键变量，而不只是模型名称本身。
